emailBody: BEP Core Fund VIII fundraising memo is now close. Project Pure is oversubscribed. Project Care is under LOI.

attachments.name: BEP Core Fund VIII.pdf
attachments.text: BEP Core Fund VIII is a private equity fund. The target fund size is $350MM. The minimum LP commitment is $5MM. The fund held an initial close with $94.5MM committed and deployed across six investments. The $255.5MM difference between the target and historical commitments was unfunded at the time of the deck. That difference is historical and is not current availability. The deck says the fund is open for new commitments. The six historical investments were Alpha Services, Beta Industrial, Gamma Business Services, Delta Logistics, Epsilon Manufacturing, and Zeta Distribution. The fund term is 10 years with two one-year extensions. Management fee is 1.75%. Performance fee/carry is 17.5% carried interest above an 8% preferred return. Upcoming investments.

attachments.name: Project Pure Co-Investment.pdf
attachments.text: Project Pure is a specialty ingredients co-investment. Revenue is $240M and adjusted EBITDA is $42M. Total co-investment availability is $80M-$105M. The deck describes allocations as open.

attachments.name: Project Care Co-Investment.pdf
attachments.text: Project Care is an adult day health and HCBS co-investment. The business operates 54 centers serving 8,000 members. Total co-investment availability is approximately $150M-$165M. The deck describes the transaction as in diligence.
